Your `api-naming` skill is very likely losing its description to the skill-listing budget. Its wording is not the problem.

## What's going on

Before any skill triggers, Claude Code loads a listing of every skill's name and description, within a fixed budget. With ~150 skills, mostly from three plugins, that listing overflows. That is what `/doctor` is warning about. When it overflows:

- **Every name stays listed**, which is why `/api-naming` still runs when you type it.
- **Whole descriptions are dropped**, starting with the skills invoked least. A skill without its description rarely triggers on its own, because Claude has nothing but the name to match against.

So nobody had to touch `api-naming`. More likely, a plugin added skills or updated their descriptions last week and pushed the total past the budget. Your skill is used less than others, so it lost its description first. Its 410-character description is well under the 1024 cap, so length isn't the cause.

**To confirm:** run `/skill-doctor`, which shows each skill's cost and use, and check whether `api-naming`'s description is dropped. The Skills row of `/context` shows the listing's size after the budget is applied.

## What to change (most effective first)

1. **Disable plugins you don't use.** A plugin's whole skill set joins the listing, so this frees the most room. If you tell me which of the three plugins you rely on, I can help work out which ones to turn off.
2. **Take name-only skills out of the listing.** For your own skills that you only ever run as `/name`, add `disable-model-invocation: true` to the frontmatter. For other skills you can use `skillOverrides` in settings to hide them or list them by name only. Note that `skillOverrides` does **not** reach plugin skills, so for those, option 1 is the lever.
3. **Raise the budget.** Use `skillListingBudgetFraction`, or set a fixed character count with `SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET`. This is the quickest fix, but every conversation then pays for a bigger listing, including the ones that never use these skills.

I wouldn't rewrite `api-naming`'s description to fix this. Trimming it saves a few hundred characters out of ~150 entries and doesn't change its spot in the least-invoked order.

After you make changes, re-run `/doctor` and `/skill-doctor` to confirm the warning is gone and `api-naming`'s description is back. Then try a prompt like "add an endpoint for listing invoices" in a fresh session to see whether it triggers on its own.

Want me to draft the settings change, or list your personal skills that are good candidates for `disable-model-invocation`?
